SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID IN ('DHJB','DHJ2')) ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.GR_NO AS KEP_GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ AS KEP_GR_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.KEY_10 AS COMPANY, SUBSTR(A.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE,1,2) AS PLANT, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.LEGACY_GR_NO, A.LEGACY_GR_SEQ, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.GR_QTY, A.GR_AMT, A.GR_DATE, A.KEY_8 AS WONGA, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.ADD_USER_NAME, A.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
